q: Is the LLM's role, version and configuration stated?
hint: Model name/version, date accessed, temperature, prompts, fine-tuning.

q: Are training/evaluation data, contamination and privacy safeguards described?
hint: Data sources, overlap with LLM pretraining, de-identification.

q: Are prompts, few-shot examples and post-processing shared?
hint: Full prompt templates, example selection, output parsing.

q: Is evaluation robust (metrics, human review, uncertainty, leakage check)?
hint: Appropriate metrics, blinded human rating, CIs, test-set independence.

q: Are hallucinations, bias and failure modes assessed?
hint: Fabrication rate, subgroup disparities, error examples.

q: Do claims respect LLM limits (no overgeneralisation)?
hint: Version drift, prompt brittleness, deployment caveats.
